clauses.text: 4.2 The certificate must be a test report from a laboratory accredited for food-contact materials (for example an FSSAI-notified laboratory), or a BIS conformity certificate for stainless steel grade 304 or better.

clauses.text: 4.6 The certificate covers the supplier, not a single item. If the supplier changes the material or the compound of a part (for example a new silicone grade), it must give a fresh test report for that part.
